drafted_from: tool:reset-daily-spend's own row (its words, input schema, sample runs and steps) and what its sample runs answered here; read it before relying on it
start_here: Say to your AI: "When a new day starts (UTC), set my AI's spend today back to zero", with {"spend_authority_ref":"spend-authority:sample-research"}. It runs tool:reset-daily-spend and answers {"reset":true,"day":"2026-11-14","total_spent_today":0}
no_lists_because: It names no list of yours: it takes its input and keeps only its own rows (spend-authority) through the records door.
instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "When a new day starts (UTC), set my AI's spend today back to zero", and give it spend_authority_ref.
2. The AI calls do_one_thing_in_my_account at @tools with method tools:run, tool tool:reset-daily-spend and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Sets the spend authority's total for today back to zero the first time it runs on a new UTC day, and remembers that day; every later run the same day changes nothing.
4. It only reads the person's own spend-authority row through the records door and writes none: the answer's `write` holds the reset for your AI to put in a store.
